query:
INSERT INTO budget (id, daily_budget, loads_today, day)
             VALUES (1, ?1, ?2, ?3)
             ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
                 loads_today = CASE WHEN budget.day = excluded.day
                     THEN budget.loads_today + excluded.loads_today
                     ELSE excluded.loads_today END,
                 day = excluded.day
